mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 7.

A massive fire ripped through a Canadian army base in Alberta, raising the death toll to five as a soldier later died from his injuries.

Kosovo's Police Inspectorate reported an 11-year delay in carrying out a court order, citing missing reports and doubts about their accuracy.

Ardian Gjini, head of the Alliance, condemned the Serbian nationalist song played at the EU-EU enlargement forum opening as an insult to Kosovo and demanded an explanation from Brussels.

Former U.S. President Joe Biden said he never fully trusted Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and defended the decision to withdraw American troops from Afghanistan.

Spain recorded a historic low against England in the Nations League, failing to register a single shot on target in the first half of the match.
